title: School World
content: I made a post on here before about my reoccurring mall dreams but I wanted to document my reoccurring school dreams also. As mentioned in my previous posts, I always have vivid or lucid dreams. It’s awesome. To the point where I enjoy sleeping a little tooo much because I like to escape to this alternate reality. School dreams can be fun.. but stressful at the same time. Pretty sure I don’t lucid dream as much in this location because I often recall feeling on edge or panicky like everything IS real and I have to follow the rules and get to class. Now to the details: I can never find my schedule.. you know, the one they send you in the mail before school starts. I frantically search my bookbag. I usually decide to head to the guidance counselor’s office for help but I can’t find my way. I also can’t find my locker. Im never sure which one is mine. I see one that might be mine and I fiddle around with the lock and spin it to random numbers that pop into my head. My bookbag is heavy and I need the books inside my locker for my next class. I end up walking into a classroom eventually- only to realize I haven’t been going to class regularly. Im way behind. How have I missed so many classes? Where have I been? The teacher is disappointed and so am I. The classrooms are massive and the desks are very spread apart. Usually an ex-classmate is the teacher. Im embarrassed. Was I held back? Why am I the oldest one here? The library is especially bizarre and I always find myself there. It’s like 3 stories high with exposed balconies made of plexiglass. There’s a spiral staircase and it makes me dizzy. If I climb to the top, I feel like I’m going to fall off. I cling onto the floor. Wtf am I doing? I always end up in gym class.. or in the locker rooms atleast. I can’t find my gym uniform. I can’t even fake a gym uniform because I’m in sandals anyway. I blink my eyes hard in an attempt to remember my schedule. Do I have gym on tuesdays? What day even is it? Welp it’s too late now.. gym class is over and now I’m roaming around wondering where I’m supposed to be next. I head to the bathroom.. and just like many reoccurring bathroom dreams, it’s just weird in there. The stalls are short so you can see the people occupying them. It’s dirty and wet with toilets overflowing. There’s much more but this is a general overview. Anyone else have these dreams? I’d love to hear similarities.
